rule: At the start of the game, several piles of matches are placed on the table, each containing at least two matches. Players alternate turns. Two moves are allowed: either remove one match from a pile, or merge two piles into one. The player who cannot make a legal move loses.

step.first: Remove 1 match from a pile, or merge two piles into one.
step.secondPile: Click another pile to merge, or the same pile again to deselect.
